class.name: ObjCObject
class.description: Represents an Objective-C object. It can be returned from Objective-C methods called on [ObjCClass] or other [ObjCObject]s. See [ObjCClassWrapper] for an example. [b]Note:[/b] This class only works on macOS. On any other platform, this class does nothing.

method.name: get_objc_class
method.description: Returns the [ObjCClass] that this object is an instance of.
